auditMethod: read-only multi-agent call-graph audit, reproduced P0/P1 countertests, sequential bounded repairs, post-fix independent re-audit
repairedFailureFamilies: macOS app collector final segment loss and natural rollover
private-mode intent loss, incomplete export, and settings failure opacity
Telegram artifact recovery, adopted ingress, ACK unknown, singleton polling, and cross-process result publication
Work settlement before recoverable result publication
checkpoint memory provenance bypass, expired restore, foreign-channel projection, and OAuth URL context leak
collector degraded intent, target-only app exclusion, and WorkHistory fact projection
Windows product environment, package entry, launcher, native helpers, and explicit host wiring
observations: Windows code-ready candidate is complete, but physical Windows package, signed install, x64/ARM64 execution, Terminal confinement, CH/UI, Explorer/Search/ACL, and two-model human qualification remain external receipts.
CH3 query-selection windows are process-memory bounded; restart safely requires a new local search and cannot reopen stale history.
M6 adaptive activation and S3-CA capability acquisition remain next-cycle scope and are not active product behavior.
Current macOS source is signing/notary ready, but this evidence does not claim that the current source package was built, notarized, installed, or released.
completionSentence: 3차 기술 완료 기준에서 실제 제품 진입점부터 사용자 surface까지 감사했고, 재현된 P0/P1은 반대시험과 순차 수리로 닫혔다. post-fix 세 감사 lane의 재현 P0/P1은 0이며 전체 제품 회귀와 실제 두 모델 smoke가 통과했다.
